# Mohammad Ali Jesar (mjesar)

> Senior full-stack Ruby on Rails engineer and AI engineer in Lahore, Pakistan, with 7+ years of production Rails experience for clients in the US and Germany, 4+ of them on Shopify and e-commerce. Builds new Rails apps and MVPs, works on existing Rails apps, adds AI features (LLM integrations, MCP servers, RAG with pgvector, agents) inside Rails, and builds Shopify and BigCommerce apps and integrations. Open to remote full-time roles, contracts and project work.

Identity: online handle mjesar. Holds a B.S. in Information Technology (Software) from Sindh Agricultural University. Available now. Based in Lahore, Pakistan (UTC+5) with flexible hours: adapts to the client's time zone, including U.S. and European business hours.

## Experience

- MGLogics (Dec 2021 to Jun 2026, remote, US clients): Ruby on Rails developer. Shopify and BigCommerce apps, catalog and order sync, Amazon SP-API integrations. Contributed, as part of a team, to five apps on the Shopify App Store, three of them also on BigCommerce.
- SimpleDeploy (Apr 2019 to Dec 2021): backend engineer. Rails REST APIs and MVP management tools for German clients in real estate and furniture.
- Education: B.S. in Information Technology (Software), Sindh Agricultural University, 2012 to 2017.

## Skills

- Rails and web: Ruby on Rails, Hotwire (Turbo, Stimulus), React, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Sidekiq, Solid Queue, REST and GraphQL APIs, RSpec, Heroku, AWS, Google Cloud, Docker.
- Shopify and e-commerce: Polaris, App Bridge, Admin and Storefront APIs (REST and GraphQL), webhooks, Shopify Functions, Checkout UI Extensions, Checkout Extensibility, Theme App Extensions, Liquid, App Store publishing, BigCommerce apps, Amazon SP-API.
- AI: LLM integrations (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, RubyLLM), MCP servers and an MCP client, RAG with pgvector on PostgreSQL, agents with tool calling, evals.
